$Comment: Old Jack, standing in the Forgotten Temple while Hallow's Eve runs. His role, this placement and
the conversation pressing F opens all ship in this pack. Interact names his conversation
(Dialogues/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack.json) rather than a screen, because he has quests
and lines to say before any list opens. Author Dialogue or Open, never both.
Requires is what makes him a guest: the feature Hallows_Eve_Live reads 1 only while the event is
switched on and running, so he arrives when it starts and leaves when it ends, is stopped by a
command, or is switched off. The library looks at every placement again at each start and end,
so neither needs a restart. Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded (which is also what lets the end of
the event find him and take him away), stands him up again if something removes him, and raises
his health past anything that can be dealt.
Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id, which stays the same on every visit while the
world's name does not. This placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character IS his role:
the pack's quests bind to Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack.
Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset: four blocks along negative X, onto the open
landing, and four and a half along positive Z. To move him, edit Anchor.WorldSpawn.Offset (small
enough to stay off the walls) and Yaw to turn him, then look at the spot in game. To take him out
without editing this file, set enabled (lower case, as that file spells it) to false for this id in
Name: Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack_Temple
